featured_reviews.name: Kunal Patankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I randomly visited Vision Express just out of curiosity to change my specs… as it had been a long time.

I first met Mr. Satish, then the optometrist Mr. Deepak, and their colleague Mr. Sriraj. I had initially gone just to see some clip-on frames… but then ended up trying multiple frames and options.

Honestly, I visited at a very odd time, around 8:30 PM, when they were almost about to close the store. But not once did they make me feel hurried. They were extremely courteous, patient and professional throughout. From trying the first frame till final billing and checkout, it was almost 11 PM… they literally extended their closing time by almost 2 hours just for one customer, and that really touched me.

They showed me a wide range of collections… hexagonal frames, wayfarers, clip-ons, newer collections, frames from the drawers, and even some from inside the boxes. Everything was shown very patiently and with genuine honest suggestions.

Mr. Deepak, the optometrist. He did not hurry at all while checking my number. We spent almost 15–20 minutes just to get the perfect number for me. Even the lens recommendation was very honest. It never felt like they were just trying to sell something for the sake of it… it genuinely felt like they were guiding me towards what would be best for me.

This was my first experience at Vision Express, and I am writing this review after receiving my spectacles. The delivery was also done almost 48 hours before the expected delivery date… which was another pleasant surprise.

Very thankful to Mr. Satish, Mr. Deepak and Mr. Sriraj for such excellent service and a genuinely warm experience. I look forward to being your customer henceforth… thank you very much.
